Scenario: End-to-end booking, acceptance and completion
Preconditions: Two registered accounts: User A (rider) and User B (driver); internet and location services on
Steps:
1. Log in as User A
2. Enter pickup and drop locations
3. Select ride type
4. Confirm booking
5. Log out A
6. Log in as User B
7. Accept ride
8. Complete ride
9. Verify payment is deducted
10. Check receipt in ride history
11. Log out B
Expected: Payment is deducted and a receipt is generated in ride history
